en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah who said,
‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Whenever you marry, so marry a (woman with) large buttocks’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn ‘Abd Allah who has said the following:
“Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘If you want to marry, marry a woman of large buttocks.’”
